original_split: Neuron-level80/20 training/testing split; cell types represented in both partitions. Not a held-cell-type protocol.
original_sampling: For acetylcholine,GABA,glutamate,at most10 presynaptic sites sampled per neuron; all sites for other transmitter classes, as described in Methods.
original_model_selection: Train1060000 iterations,batch16; final checkpoint selected for highest classification accuracy on the testing set.
reported_output: Whole-neuron confusion matrix on that model-selection-used testing set, after summing predicted class probabilities across each neurons presynaptic detections.
interpretation: Training/testing neuron separation does not make the reported selected-test result an untouched final evaluation or a held-cell-type generalization estimate.
required_provenance: Exact neuron split and cell-type overlap policy
Testing accuracy used for checkpoint selection and selected-checkpoint identity
Any tie-breaking/selection detail actually used; missing details remain a gap
Reported confusion-matrix cohort and original source/model versions
missing_history_disposition: required_unscorable_original_selection_provenance; do not silently fix the historical procedure or rename its testing set an independent final holdout
